Amanda R.: quick heads-up — saw a latency bump on the vector/rerank endpoint after last night's kernel selector change. p95 for rerank_search went from ~120ms -> ~210ms. can we get token-level breakdowns in the dashboard?
Ben K.: ugh. I repro'd locally — attention kernel fell back from our optimized cutlass path to the generic aten path for seq_len=512. that added ~22ms/token on the attention pass for the model we use.
Carlos M.: FYI the rollout also changed batching heuristics (smaller max_batch for rerank to reduce cold-start). combined with a KV cache hit-rate dip it reduced effective batching QPS. KV hits dropped from 78% -> 54% on that route.
Amanda R.: ok, two vectors here: kernel fallback (attention time) + smaller batch+kv effects. I'd like a per-route token latency breakdown by phase: tokenize->encode->attn->kv-lookup->decode. also need p50/p95/p99.
Devon S.: agree. recommending a histogram metric `runtime_token_phase_latency_ms` with labels {route, phase, kernel, model_variant}. then add panels: stacked breakdown by phase (p95), kernel heatmap (p99), and batch-size distribution. PromQL examples: ```
# p95 per-phase for route
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_token_phase_latency_ms_bucket{route="rerank_search"}[5m])) by (le, phase))

# kernel fallback ratio
sum(rate(runtime_token_phase_latency_ms_count{route="rerank_search",kernel!="optimized"}[10m]))
/ sum(rate(runtime_token_phase_latency_ms_count{route="rerank_search"}[10m]))
```
Ben K.: also capture `kv_hit` label on the histogram or a separate `kv_hit_ratio{route}` timeseries. small batches amplify the opcode overhead — add a panel for avg_batch_size and its tail.
Carlos M.: I'll add panels in the per-route dashboard and a new alert if p95(attn phase) > 180ms for 5m. is that threshold sane?
Amanda R.: sounds good. also add an exploratory flamegraph link for last night's repro: https://perf.redwood.internal/flame/1781234500 — shows attention kernel hotpath and a lot of short-lived memcpy ops.
Devon S.: I'll add buckets [0.5,1,2,4,8,16,32,64] ms and the route label. will push a PR for the metrics + grafana dashboard changes.
infra-bot: deploy pipeline: rolled out `kernel-selector v2` to canary (rerank_search) at 1781234400. monitoring will pick up new metrics once PR merges. :rocket:
Ben K.: quick note — when you add the kernel label, include values: optimized, fallback_cutlass, aten_generic. that'll make the heatmap clearer.
Amanda R.: thanks team. action items: (1) Devon PR for histograms + buckets, (2) Carlos dashboard panels + alert, (3) Ben follow-up on memcpy source, (4) me to run regression with larger batch sizes to see kv/batch interplay. will check again after PRs land. :thumbsup:
